meta.scope: Japan batch 1 — Phase 0+1 complete. Core national statistical system under expanded node definition: foundational Statistics Act (2007), Statistics Bureau / MIC coordination role, Population Census, CPI, Labour Force Survey, Family Income & Expenditure Survey, National Accounts (CAO/ESRI), Economic Census, Bank of Japan Monetary Base & Flow of Funds, Balance of Payments (MOF/BOJ). Asia excl. China/India start. Definition locked; no changes.
meta.strategy_note: Follows NEXT-COUNTRY-STRATEGY.md: logs first, definition locked, national statistical office catalogue (SBJ + e-Stat + CAO + BOJ) first, hierarchy template ready for later batches (Tokyo metro, prefectures, key municipalities). Batches of ~10–12.

candidates.title: Statistics Act (Act No. 53 of 2007) — 統計法
candidates.publisher: National Diet of Japan / Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC)
candidates.description: Foundational statute that comprehensively reformed Japan’s official statistics system. Defines official statistics as information infrastructure, establishes fundamental statistics (基幹統計) and fundamental statistical surveys, creates the Statistics Commission, requires a Master Plan concerning the Development of Official Statistics, and sets rules for statistical surveys, confidentiality, secondary use, and coordination across the highly decentralised Japanese statistical system. Replaced the 1947 Statistics Act.
referenced_by: All fundamental statistical survey methodologies and implementation plans
Master Plan Concerning the Development of Official Statistics (Cabinet decision)
Statistics Commission deliberations and annual reports
MIC Director-General for Policy Planning (Statistical Policy) institutional documents
IMF SDDS / DQAF assessments of Japanese statistics
OECD reviews of the Japanese statistical system
candidates.notes:
Prime static + recurring-citation node — direct analogue of Mexico’s LSNIEG and Argentina’s Ley 17.622.

Article 1 states the purpose: ‘to promote systematic and efficient development of official statistics and to ensure the usefulness thereof through specifying basic matters concerning the production and provision of official statistics, and thereby to contribute to sound development of the national economy and enhancement of the living standards of the citizens.’

Official statistics are explicitly recognised as ‘information infrastructure’ usable not only by administration but by society as a whole. Fundamental statistics include the Population Census statistics, National Accounts, and other statistics designated by the Minister of Internal Affairs and Communications. Every subsequent methodological document, survey approval, and quality report cites the 2007 Act as the legal foundation. No independent publication cadence is required; continuous institutional citation satisfies the expanded node definition.

candidates.title: Statistics Bureau of Japan (SBJ) / 総務省統計局 — Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications (MIC)
candidates.description: Central statistical office responsible for producing many of Japan’s fundamental statistics (Population Census, Labour Force Survey, CPI, Family Income and Expenditure Survey, Economic Census, etc.) and for cross-governmental coordination of the decentralised official statistical system under the Statistics Act. Works with the National Statistics Center (NSTAC) for data processing and the Statistics Commission for oversight.
referenced_by: All SBJ survey methodological notes and press releases
Cabinet Office National Accounts source documentation
candidates.notes: Institutional framework node. Japan’s statistical system is highly decentralised by international standards; SBJ plays the dual role of major producer and coordinator. Continuously referenced as the lead agency for fundamental statistics and for the e-Stat portal.

candidates.title: Population Census of Japan (国勢調査 / Kokusei Chōsa)
candidates.publisher: Statistics Bureau of Japan (SBJ), Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
candidates.description: Quinquennial complete enumeration of the population and households of Japan. Provides the benchmark for population estimates, sampling frames for virtually all household surveys, and the demographic base for national accounts, labour force, and many other statistics. Conducted every five years since 1920 (with wartime interruption). The 2020 Census was the 21st; the 2025 Census (22nd) results are emerging.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics under the Statistics Act. Serves as the primary sampling frame and population control totals for the Labour Force Survey, Family Income and Expenditure Survey, and many other programmes. Results feed directly into Population Estimates, National Accounts employment and household sector accounts, and prefectural accounts. 2020 Census total population: approximately 126.2 million; 2025 preliminary figures show continued decline.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index (CPI) / 消費者物価指数
candidates.description: Monthly measure of the average change in prices of goods and services purchased by households throughout Japan. 2020-base index currently in use. Covers all Japan and major regions/cities; also publishes Tokyo-area early indicators. Core and other analytical series released.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics. Compiled primarily from the Retail Price Survey. Widely used for inflation targeting discussions, real wage calculations, national accounts deflation, and poverty/income analysis. June 2026: +1.7% year-on-year. Disseminated under SDDS.

candidates.title: Labour Force Survey (労働力調査)
candidates.description: Monthly household survey providing official unemployment rate, labour force participation, employment by industry/occupation, hours worked, and related labour market indicators for persons aged 15 and over. Basic Tabulation monthly; Detailed Tabulation quarterly.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics and primary source for the official unemployment rate (June 2026 seasonally adjusted: 2.5%). Sampling frame derived from Population Census. Results feed into National Accounts employment and compensation estimates, and are continuously cited in BOJ and Cabinet Office economic assessments.

candidates.title: Family Income and Expenditure Survey (家計調査 / Kakei Chōsa)
candidates.description: Monthly survey of household income, expenditure, savings and debt for two-or-more-person households (and separately for one-person and total households). Provides detailed consumption structure data used for CPI weights, national accounts private consumption estimates, and living-standards analysis.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics. Core input into CPI basket weights and into the expenditure-side estimates of GDP. June 2026 real consumption expenditures for two-or-more-person households: −3.3% year-on-year. Complements the quinquennial National Survey of Family Income, Consumption and Wealth.

candidates.title: Japanese System of National Accounts (JSNA) / 国民経済計算 — Annual Report and Quarterly Estimates
candidates.publisher: Economic and Social Research Institute (ESRI), Cabinet Office
candidates.description: Full system of national accounts compiled in accordance with the 2008 SNA (benchmark year currently 2020). Produces GDP by production, expenditure and income approaches, institutional sector accounts, supply-use tables, capital stock, and related aggregates. Quarterly preliminary estimates (QE) and annual report.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics under the Statistics Act (explicitly listed). Compiled by the Department of National Accounts of ESRI. Draws heavily on SBJ source statistics (Population Census, Economic Census, Labour Force Survey, Family Income and Expenditure Survey, CPI, etc.), Ministry of Finance data, and BOJ financial statistics. Benchmark revisions approximately every five years incorporate new Input-Output tables and census results. 2008 SNA introduced in 2016; current benchmark year 2020.

candidates.title: Economic Census (経済センサス) — Business Frame and Business Activity
candidates.publisher: Statistics Bureau of Japan (SBJ) in cooperation with Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI)
candidates.description: Large-scale census of establishments and enterprises providing the statistical business register (JSBR) frame and detailed economic activity data. Conducted periodically (Economic Census for Business Frame and for Business Activity). Foundation for annual and monthly business surveys and for national accounts production estimates.
candidates.notes: Fundamental statistics. Provides the sampling frame and structural benchmarks for the Annual Business Survey, Monthly Survey on Service Industries, and many METI industrial statistics. Critical input into National Accounts production-side estimates and the statistical business register maintained with NSTAC profiling support for large enterprises.

candidates.title: Monetary Base Statistics / マネタリーベース
candidates.publisher: Bank of Japan (BOJ) — Research and Statistics Department
candidates.description: Monthly statistics on the monetary base (banknotes in circulation + coins in circulation + current account balances at the Bank of Japan). Published with average amounts outstanding, end-of-period figures, and year-on-year growth rates. Key indicator of the stance of monetary policy and liquidity conditions.
candidates.notes: Core high-frequency monetary aggregate. Continuously cited in BOJ monetary policy statements, Outlook for Economic Activity and Prices, and market analysis. May 2026 data show continued contraction in year-on-year growth consistent with the post-YCC normalisation phase. Complements the broader Monetary Base and the Bank of Japan’s Transactions series.

candidates.title: Flow of Funds Accounts (FFA) / 資金循環統計
candidates.publisher: Bank of Japan (BOJ) — Research and Statistics Department
candidates.description: Quarterly integrated accounts of financial assets and liabilities by institutional sector (households, non-financial corporations, financial institutions, general government, central bank, overseas). Provides from-whom-to-whom matrices for major instruments and is a key input into national accounts financial accounts and stock estimates.
candidates.notes: Major BOJ statistical product. Retroactively revised annually to incorporate new source data and methodological improvements. Directly used in the compilation of the financial accounts of the JSNA and in analyses of household and corporate balance-sheet adjustment. Q1 2026 preliminary figures released June 2026.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and International Investment Position (BPM6) / 国際収支統計・対外資産負債残高
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Finance (MOF) and Bank of Japan (jointly)
candidates.description: Monthly and quarterly balance-of-payments statistics and annual international investment position compiled according to the IMF’s BPM6. Covers current account, capital account, financial account, and external assets/liabilities. Detailed breakdowns by partner economy, industry (for direct investment), and currency available.
candidates.notes: Compiled by the Bank of Japan under entrustment from the Minister of Finance pursuant to the Foreign Exchange and Foreign Trade Act. Core SDDS data category. Continuously referenced in MOF and BOJ economic reports, national accounts rest-of-world accounts, and international comparisons. Data from January 2014 onward on BPM6 basis.

candidates.title: e-Stat — Portal Site of Official Statistics of Japan
candidates.publisher: Statistics Bureau of Japan / National Statistics Center (NSTAC)
candidates.description: Central government statistical data portal providing unified access to statistics produced by all ministries and agencies. Includes API access, visualisation tools, release calendars, and the full catalogue of official statistics. Primary dissemination channel for SBJ and many other producers.
referenced_by: International data users and API consumers
candidates.notes: Institutional dissemination infrastructure node. While not a statistical series itself, it is the load-bearing public face of the official statistical system and is continuously cited as the authoritative source for Japanese government statistics. Supports the secondary-use provisions of the Statistics Act.
